ideas.idea: Remove /contact from the sitemap (noindex page listed)
ideas.why: Hmm, this is the known problem already listed, but it is restated; skip-worthy though accurate.

ideas.idea: Render FAQ answers as visible text on the home page, not only in JSON-LD
ideas.why: index.astro only places the answers in the script, so visible content lacks them.

ideas.idea: Add a table of mooring sizes and seasonal prices to /moorings
ideas.why: The description promises sizes and seasonal prices but the page only says prices start at £40.

ideas.idea: Set `site` in an Astro config and derive canonicals/sitemap from it
ideas.why: No astro.config exists and the origin is hardcoded in Base.astro.

ideas.idea: Add charset and viewport meta tags and a <main> element
ideas.why: Base.astro has none of these, so it is accurate and concrete, though common advice.

ideas.idea: Link to the moorings page from the home page body text
ideas.why: The nav already links to /moorings, so extra in-text links add little.

ideas.idea: Add Organization/LocalBusiness JSON-LD on the home page with name, location and phone
ideas.why: No entity identity is declared anywhere in the markup and the phone is only on a noindex page.

ideas.idea: Make the home title mention Falmouth to match the h1
ideas.why: The title says Cornwall while the h1 and description say Falmouth, so naming the town helps.

ideas.idea: Add <lastmod> to sitemap entries once real dates exist
ideas.why: Accurate but low-impact for a three-URL sitemap.

ideas.idea: Use `robots ?? "index, follow"` or omit the robots tag when unset
ideas.why: It is just the fix for the known max-snippet problem, and "index, follow" is the default anyway.

ideas.idea: If the crawler block is deliberate, add policy.aiSearchCrawlers to geo.config.json
ideas.why: It depends on the audit tool's own config and is not specific to the site's files.
